prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied 3x3 reference atlas of this same Daggerfall pixel-art woman's upper face into nine natural gaze directions. Preserve her identity, head shape, hair, palette, expression and framing. Each cell remains the complete upper portrait, 64:35 aspect, no gutters, borders, labels or text. Return only the 3x3 atlas.

Row-major directions, as viewed on the picture: TOP-LEFT, UP, TOP-RIGHT / LEFT, STRAIGHT AHEAD, RIGHT / BOTTOM-LEFT, DOWN, BOTTOM-RIGHT. The two pupils must point together. The diagonals must visibly include the vertical component, rather than repeat the horizontal glance.

CRITICAL ANATOMY: render each iris, pupil, eye opening and eyelids as one coherent eye. Looking UP naturally raises the UPPER EYELID and opens the eyes somewhat more, making actual room inside the eyeball opening for the elevated iris and pupil. Keep the pupil visibly INSIDE that opening, never stamped on top of the lid or skin. Small natural lower-lid adjustments are allowed. Looking DOWN lowers the gaze within a naturally lowered upper lid, with the iris correctly occluded by lids. Do not keep the old narrow opening fixed while pushing pupils through it. Do not shift the whole eye socket or eyebrows to simulate gaze. Keep eye corners and eye spacing stable, permit the lid contour to follow the gaze. Keep a continuous anatomically believable lid outline, no severed iris and no pupil embedded in eyelid.

The original is low-resolution softly shaded pixel art: retain compact muted violet-gray irises, tiny restrained highlights, warm subdued whites and the original brown/skin palette. Keep the original square pixel lattice, no round vector pupils, no new bright-white crescent or huge doll eyes. UP is a modest natural widening of these specific eyes, not a startled expression. The middle-center cell matches the reference exactly. Keep brows and all skin/hair/background outside the eye features unchanged. Prioritize natural readable gaze over a forced exact one-pixel movement or a fixed iris bounding rectangle.
